page.layout: One printed page: ornamental rule and title block at top (heading lines), then one text block of verse with a historiated initial at the left; page number at top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: MARTINI MARLOREI, BARRENSIS CAVSIDICI, Euangelicę veritatis persecutoris acerrimi,
EPITAPHIVM.

page.notes: Initial "I" is a woodcut historiated initial, read as I. Page number 73 is printed at top right. Some letters in the verse are blurred; "Vexanit" and "Terentl" read as printed. The first verse lines are set in italic mixed with roman.
